content:
Devon: hey team :wave: does anyone have the prod service overview/dashboard link for model-gateway-east? I can see the card but when I click through I get a 403 from Grafana. Need to triage a customer issue quickly.

Sara: which grafana URL are you hitting (cloud/prod)? and what user are you signed in as?

Devon: prod — https://grafana.prod.redwood.com/d/abcd/model-gateway (403). Signed in as devon@redwood.com. Screenshot attached in thread.

Andre: 403 usually means you don't have the monitoring-viewer role (we moved some panels to org-level view recently). Confirmed the dashboard is the new service-overview composed panel.

Sara: try this shortlink first: https://go.redwood/g/model-gateway-prod and see if that redirects for you. If still 403, you'll need RBAC.

Devon: tried the shortlink, still 403. Error shows "You are not authorized to view this dashboard".

Andre: ok — two quick options:
1) submit an access request (preferred) — go to https://id.redwood.com/access-requests, select "Monitoring / Grafana - Viewer" and include service: model-gateway-east. Approvals are auto-routed to infra.
2) temporary add — @Liam can add you to the monitoring-viewer group for 1hr if it's urgent.

ops-bot: Access request template: Please include the Grafana path and justification. Auto-tags: #grafana #monitoring.

Liam: I can do the temp add. Devon — confirm you only need view, not edit.

Devon: only view. Thanks!

Liam: done — added Devon to monitoring-viewer (expires in 1h). Try again and ping if still 403.

Devon: works now, can see service-overview and model-health panels :thumbsup: One follow-up — the "EU-west" region tiles on that dashboard are empty for model-gateway-east. Are those not hooked up yet?

Andre: yeah those panels are backed by the new regional metrics pipeline; eu-west ingestion got delayed this morning during rolling push. I opened #infra-ticket-289 to track. If you need traces/logs immediately, use Loki link: https://loki.prod.redwood.com/explore?orgId=1&query=%7Bservice%3D%22model-gateway-east%22%7D and traces at Jaeger: https://jaeger.prod.redwood.com/search?service=model-gateway-east

Devon: perfect — using Loki now. Filing a quick postmortem note and will link infra-ticket-289 in the customer update. Thanks all.

Sara: filing a follow-up to ensure EU panels fall back to global metrics when regional is delayed — tagging @observability for an alert/regression check.

Devon: noted. cc @CustomerOps on the update.

Liam: closing temp access in 1h, remember to submit the access request if you need ongoing visibility.

Devon: will do. Thanks everyone!
